blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) that continue improving after deployment (e.g., recursive self-improvement) offer a promising path toward general intelligence. Current test-time methods pursue this goal on unlabeled questions, primarily relying on self-consistency: they generate independent solutions and use majority voting to select an answer or construct training targets. This leaves earlier reasoning unused at inference and can reinforce an incorrect majority during training. Humans instead build on earlier attempts to preserve useful reasoning, correct mistakes and improve their problem-solving strategies. Following this principle, we propose Test-Time Recursive Self-Improvement (TT-RSI), a label-free framework for improving LLMs at test time through two mutually reinforcing components: (1) In-Context RSI repeatedly re-solves each question using the full previous solution as a reference, letting the model decide whether and how to use it so that inference compute builds on earlier reasoning. (2) In-Weight RSI distills successive refinements into the model's weights, enabling progress beyond an initially wrong majority and theoretically bringing the first attempt toward the model's infinite-step refinement limit. The updated model answers better and refines more effectively, generating stronger references for subsequent training. Extensive experiments show that TT-RSI improves average accuracy by +13.89% over the base model and outperforms the strongest self-consistency-based method by +4.79% under the same test-time scaling budget.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Enabling AI systems to improve their own capabilities (e.g., recursive self-improvement ( Novikov et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) and continual learning ( Ye et al., 2026 ) ) is central to progress toward artificial general intelligence ( Schmidhuber, 2007 ; Silver and Sutton, 2025 ) .
For LLMs, test time is a natural setting for such improvement:
after a model is deployed, the goal is to answer new, unlabeled
questions more accurately using only self-generated signals.
Two families of methods pursue this goal: test-time scaling spends more inference compute on each question ( Snell et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) , while test-time training updates the model’s weights on unlabeled test questions ( Sun et al., 2020 ; Zuo et al., 2025 ) .
Ideally, the two form a loop: better answers train a better model, which in turn produces better answers, allowing improvements to accumulate over successive rounds without external supervision.
blocks.zh:
使人工智能系统能够提高自身能力(例如,递归性自我改进(Novikov等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年)和持续学习(Ye等人,2026年)),是朝着人工一般智能进步的关键(Schmidhuber,2007年;Silver和Sutton,2025年)。
对于LLMS来说,测试时间是这种改进的自然背景:
在使用模型后,目标是回答新的,没有标签的
问题只使用自生成的信号。
两个方法家族追求这一目标:测试时间缩放在每一个问题上花费更多的推论计算(Snell等人,2025年;Guo等人,2025年),而测试时间培训更新模型对无标签测试问题的权重(Sun等人,2020年;Zuo等人,2025年).
理想的情况是,两者形成一个循环:更好的答案训练一个更好的模型,这反过来又产生更好的答案,使得改进可以在没有外部监督的连续回合中积累.

blocks.en:
However, current test-time methods rely primarily on Self-Consistency (SC) for both inference and training: they sample independent solutions and use majority voting either to select the final answer ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Brown et al., 2024 ) or to construct training targets ( Zuo et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Gkountouras et al., 2026 ) .
This leads to two linked limitations: (1) Inefficient inference. Each attempt starts from scratch and leaves earlier reasoning unused, so additional compute yields more independent samples rather than better reasoning. (2) Unreliable supervision. Majority voting rewards whichever answer the model already produces most often, so when that majority is wrong, training reinforces the error.
Together, these limitations break the loop above, so test-time improvement stalls rather than accumulates.
blocks.zh:
然而,目前的测试时间方法主要依靠自我一致性(SC)进行推论和培训:它们抽取独立解决方案,并使用多数投票来选择最终答案(Wang等人,2023年;Brown等人,2024年)或构建培训目标(Zuo等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年;Gkountouras等人,2026年).
这导致了两个相互关联的限制:(1) 无效推论. 每次尝试都是从零开始,使得早期的推理没有被使用,所以额外的计算产生更独立的样本而不是更好的推理. (2)不可靠的监督。 多数投票的奖励以模式已经产生的答案为准,因此,当多数投票结果错误时,培训会强化错误。
这些限制一起打破了上面的循环,因此测试时间的改进档而不是积累.

blocks.en:
In contrast, humans tackle difficult problems by building on earlier attempts, retaining useful reasoning, revising mistakes, and gradually improving their problem-solving strategies ( Pólya, 1945 ) .
Following this principle, we propose Test-Time Recursive Self-Improvement (TT-RSI), a label-free framework that improves LLMs at test time through both inference and training ( Figure 1 ).
Both rely on an improvement step , which re-solves a question with the previous solution as context. Specifically,
at inference, additional compute builds on earlier reasoning instead of repeating it.
During training, the model learns from its own refinements rather than majority votes.
Since a refinement can fix an earlier attempt even when most attempts agree on a wrong answer, this supervision can move the model beyond its initial majority,
yielding higher accuracy than majority-based training while
preserving the gains from further test-time scaling.
blocks.zh:
相比之下,人类通过在先前的尝试基础上再接再厉,保留有用的推理,修正错误,并逐步改进其解决问题的战略(Pólya, 1945年)来解决困难问题.
遵循这一原则,我们提出试验-时间递归自我改进(TT-RSI),这是一个无标签的框架,通过推论和培训在试验时改进LLMs(图1)。
两者都依赖于一个改进步骤,这个步骤以前一个解决办法作为上下文重新解决问题。 具体来说,
在推论中,额外的计算基于先前的推理,而不是重复。
在训练期间,该模式学习的是其自身的完善而不是多数选票.
由于即使大多数尝试都同意错误的答案,改进可以纠正早先的尝试,这种监督可以使模式超越最初的多数,
准确度高于基于多数的培训,同时
保持进一步试验时间缩放的收益。

blocks.en:
TT-RSI realizes the improvement step through two complementary components.
At inference, we introduce In-Context RSI , a training-free test-time scaling strategy that turns additional compute into successive refinements.
Given a question, the LLM first generates an initial solution, then repeatedly re-solves the question with its latest solution as context, and returns the final answer of the last attempt.
However, simply conditioning on previous solutions can restrict exploration and cause repetition ( Gu et al., 2026 ; Rance et al., 2026 ) .
We therefore present the full solution neutrally, preserving its intermediate reasoning while letting the LLM decide whether and how to use it.
With the previous solution in view, the LLM need not re-derive every step: it can keep verified steps, focus on questionable ones, and avoid repeating earlier dead ends.
As a result, In-Context RSI surpasses self-consistency while reducing generated tokens by a relative 68.6% ( Figure 3 ).
These successive solutions also serve as training signals.
blocks.zh:
TT-RSI通过两个互补的组成部分意识到改进步骤.
推论一下,我们引入了In-Context RSI,这是一种免费测试时间缩放策略,将额外的计算转化为连续的改进.
鉴于一个问题,LLM首先生成一个初始解决方案,然后以它作为上下文的最新解决方案反复重解问题,并返回最后一次尝试的最终答案.
然而,仅仅对先前的解决方案加以限定,可能会限制勘探并造成重复(Gu等人,2026年;Rance等人,2026年)。
因此,我们中立地提出全面解决办法,保留其中间推理,同时让LLM决定是否以及如何使用它。
考虑到先前的解决方案,LLM不需要每一步都重新定型:它可以保持经核实的步骤,专注于有问题的步骤,并避免重蹈先前的死胡同.
因此,in-Context RSI超越了自我一致性,同时减少了相对68.6%的生成符(图3).
这些连续的解决方案也作为训练信号.

blocks.en:
During training, we introduce In-Weight RSI , a label-free test-time training method that distills the gains of In-Context RSI into the model’s weights.
In-Weight RSI uses the first attempt and its immediate refinement, a pair of adjacent solutions from an In-Context RSI chain generated by the current policy, as references, strengthening both answering and refinement while transferring later improvements into the first attempt. Concretely, it learns from these references through on-policy self-distillation ( Zhao et al., 2026a , OPSD;) , which turns them into token-level guidance on the model’s own rollouts.
Because each refinement re-examines the full previous derivation, it can correct intermediate steps even when the final answer remains wrong.
Token-level guidance captures such partial corrections, which majority voting over final answers cannot.
In this way, In-Context RSI and In-Weight RSI reinforce each other: the refinements of In-Context RSI train a better model through In-Weight RSI, and the updated model refines more effectively under In-Context RSI, generating stronger references for later training.
This realizes the ideal loop between test-time scaling and training described above, so improvements can be accumulated without external supervision.
blocks.zh:
在训练期间,我们引入了In-Wight RSI,一种无标签的测试-时间训练方法,将In-Context RSI的收获提炼成模型的权重.
In-Wight RSI将第一次尝试及其即刻的改进,即当前政策产生的一对in-Context RSI链的相邻解决方案作为参考,加强回答和完善,同时将后来的改进转移到第一次尝试中. 具体地说,它通过政策自我消化从这些参考中吸取了教训(Zhao等人,2026a, OPSD; ), 将这些参考转化为关于模型自身推出的象征性指导。
因为每次改进都会重新审视之前的全部推论,即使最后的答案仍然是错误的,它也能纠正中间步骤.
肯德基层面的指导抓住了这种部分更正,而多数人对最后答案的表决是无法做到的。
这样,In-Context RSI和In-Wight RSI相互加强:In-Context RSI的改进通过In-Wight RSI训练了一个更好的模型,更新的模型在In-Context RSI下进行了更有效的改进,为以后的培训提供了更强的参考.
这实现了上述测试时间缩放与培训之间理想的循环,因此无需外部监督就可以积累改进.

blocks.en:
We validate TT-RSI with Qwen3-1.7B, 4B and 8B ( Yang et al., 2025a ) on five competition mathematics benchmarks ( Balunović et al., 2025 ; Dekoninck et al., 2026 ) against five label-free baselines.
In-Weight RSI and the full TT-RSI improve average accuracy over the base model by +5.79% and +13.89% , respectively.
Under the same test-time scaling budget, TT-RSI exceeds the strongest self-consistency-based method, TTPO + SC ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , by +4.79% on average.
Our contributions are as follows: • A recursive self-improvement framework. We propose TT-RSI, which goes beyond self-consistency by using self-improvement for both test-time scaling and label-free test-time training. • Two mutually reinforcing components. We design In-Context RSI to let the model build on its full previous solution, and In-Weight RSI to distill successive refinements into answering and refinement, so that each strengthens the other. • Theory and experiments. We prove that distilling from two successive solutions strengthens refinement and moves the first attempt toward the infinite-step limit, and demonstrate accuracy and token-efficiency gains empirically.

blocks.en: 3.1 The improvement step
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 改进步骤

blocks.en:
At the core of TT-RSI is an improvement step , which lets the model improve on its own attempts without labels by turning a completed attempt into context for further reasoning.
A previous solution provides a starting point from which the model can reuse useful parts of an argument, reconsider intermediate steps, and develop a better solution.
Starting from a 1 ∼ π θ ( ⋅ ∣ q ) a_{1}\sim\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid q) , repeated application gives a k + 1 ∼ π θ ( ⋅ ∣ q , a k ) a_{k+1}\sim\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid q,a_{k}) .
Only the latest solution a k a_{k} is carried forward, so the sequence forms a Markov chain without an expanding history.
Because later solutions tend to improve on earlier ones ( Figure 3 ), they can also supervise earlier attempts during training, distilling later improvements into the model ( Section 3.3 ).
Further details of the refinement setup are provided in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 3.2 In-Context RSI
blocks.zh: 3.2 内文RSI

blocks.en:
Even an unsuccessful attempt often contains correct intermediate steps, yet independent sampling discards them and starts each attempt from scratch.
To put them to use, we propose In-Context RSI, a training-free test-time scaling strategy that applies the improvement step repeatedly to the same question, so that each attempt builds on the previous one.
Effective refinement needs information from an earlier attempt and the freedom to reconsider it.
Yet conditioning too strongly on an earlier solution can suppress exploration and lead to repeated solutions ( Gu et al., 2026 ; Rance et al., 2026 ) .
Directly applying correction-oriented feedback can also induce unnecessary changes to a correct answer ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Kamoi et al., 2024 ) .

即使是不成功的尝试也往往包含正确的中间步骤,然而独立取样却抛弃它们,从头开始每次尝试.
为了将其付诸使用,我们提议采用无培训测试时间缩放战略In-Context RSI,将改进步骤反复适用于同一问题,以使每次尝试都以前一次为基础。
有效的改进需要从早先的尝试中获得信息,并有重新考虑它的自由。
然而,对更早的解决办法过于严格的限制可以抑制勘探,导致重复解决办法(Gu等人,2026年;Rance等人,2026年)。
直接应用面向纠正的反馈,也可能诱发对正确答案的不必要的修改(Huang等人,2024;Kamoi等人,2024).

blocks.en:
To address this tension, In-Context RSI combines full-solution references with autonomous reference use.
Given q q , the policy first generates an initial solution a 1 ∼ π θ ( ⋅ ∣ q ) a_{1}\sim\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid q) .
Each subsequent attempt then receives a full-solution reference : the complete previous solution a k a_{k} , including both its step-by-step derivation and its final answer, rather than the final answer alone.
Attempt a k + 1 a_{k+1} can thus check the individual steps of a k a_{k} , keep those that hold, and locate where the derivation went wrong, so even a solution with an incorrect final answer contributes reusable steps.
For autonomous reference use , we present a k a_{k} neutrally as “a previous attempt”, without indicating whether it is correct or requesting corrections, and ask the policy to “solve the problem independently” ( Appendix B ).
The policy itself decides how to use each part of a k a_{k} : reuse it, rework it, or take a new approach.
Repeating this step yields a chain a 1 → a 2 → ⋯ → a ℓ a_{1}\to a_{2}\to\cdots\to a_{\ell} of one initial solution and ℓ − 1 \ell{-}1 refinements, and we return the final answer of a ℓ a_{\ell} .

blocks.en:
The improvements of In-Context RSI last only for the current question, and majority-vote targets can reinforce a wrong answer.
We therefore propose In-Weight RSI, a label-free test-time training method that distills successive refinements into the model’s weights.
Taking the first two solutions a 1 , a 2 a_{1},a_{2} of an In-Context RSI chain generated by π θ \pi_{\theta} as references, In-Weight RSI trains answering and refinement through Recursive Distillation and couples them through Accelerated Distillation, optimizing both objectives jointly.
Both use OPSD ( Eq. 1 ), with these references as privileged information.
blocks.zh:

因此,我们提出In-Wight RSI,一种无标签的测试时间训练方法,将连续的精度提炼成模型的权重.

两者都使用OPSD(Eq. 1),这些引用作为特权信息.

blocks.en:
A key design question is which solution along the refinement chain should supervise which attempt.
Ideally, training would transfer the result of infinitely many refinements directly into the first attempt, absorbing the full benefit of the chain.
However, long chains are costly to generate, and their late solutions can differ substantially from the student’s early attempts, making the teacher’s guidance on the student’s own rollouts less reliable. This raises a question: is it possible to supervise only local relationships along the chain and thereby avoid these issues?

一个关键的设计问题是,在改进环节中应采用哪种解决办法来监督哪种尝试。

然而,长链的产生成本很高,其晚期解决方案可能与学生的早期尝试有很大不同,使得教师对学生自己推出课程的指导不那么可靠. 这就提出了一个问题:能否仅监督整个链条上的地方关系,从而避免这些问题?

Every later step reuses the refinement operation, so training these two behaviors covers the recurring roles along the chain.

We call L ref L_{\mathrm{ref}} refinement distillation : its teacher has seen the refined solution a 2 a_{2} , so it trains the improvement step to incorporate a further refinement.
We combine them as L Rec = L ans + L ref . L_{\mathrm{Rec}}=L_{\mathrm{ans}}+L_{\mathrm{ref}}. (3) Although L Rec L_{\mathrm{Rec}} needs only two reference solutions per question, it can recover the effect of much longer chains over repeated updates.

Distilling them again moves the first attempt and each refinement step further along that chain.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
First, under the same test-time scaling budget, TT-RSI outperforms self-consistency-based test-time training at every model scale (see Table 1 ).
On average, it exceeds TTPO + SC by +4.79% , with wins in 11 of the 15 settings and ties in two.
On AIME26 at 8B, for example, accuracy is 86.67% , compared with 73.33% for TTPO + SC ( +13.34% ).
Self-consistency-based training can reinforce an incorrect majority, so further sampling tends to reproduce the same error: in the same setting, self-consistency lifts TTPO by only +2.50% , whereas In-Context RSI lifts Base by +8.89% .
Training on refinements instead strengthens revision, improving the solutions that later attempts build on.

首先,在相同的测试时间缩放预算下,TT-RSI在每一个模型尺度上都超过了基于自我一致性的测试时间培训(见表1).
平均比 TTPO + SC 高4.79%,在15个设置中的11个和两个关联中获胜.
例如,在8B的AIME26中,准确率为86.67%,而TTPO + SC(+13.34%)为73.33%。
自我一致的训练可以强化一个不正确的多数,因此进一步的取样往往会重复同样的错误:在同一环境下,自我一致的升降TTPO只有+2.50%,而In-Context RSI升降基地只有+8.89%.
相反,关于改进的培训加强了修订工作,改进了后来试图利用的解决办法。

Second, even without test-time scaling, In-Weight RSI achieves the best first-attempt accuracy among label-free training methods at every model scale.
It improves over Base by +5.79% on average, beating all five training baselines in 13 of the 15 settings and tying for the best score in one other.
At 8B, its mean accuracy is 64.17% , +2.34% above TTPO ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , the strongest training baseline on average.
These gains show that distillation retains refinement benefits in the model and remains effective with a stronger starting policy.
blocks.zh:
第二,即使没有测试时间的缩放,In-Wight RSI也在每个模型尺度的无标签训练方法中实现了最好的第一试精度.
平均比基地提高5.79%,在15个环境的13个中击败所有5个培训基线,并在另一个环境获得最佳分数。
8B时,其平均精度为64.17%,比TTPO(Wang等人,2026年)高2.34%,是平均最强的训练基线.
这些成果表明,提炼保留了模型的精细化效益,并通过更强有力的起始政策保持效力。

blocks.en:
Third, the gains from training also carry over to inference-time refinement.
Specifically, the full framework gains +13.89% over Base and exceeds Base + In-Context RSI by +7.33% .
In-Weight RSI therefore helps even when in-context improvement is available at inference, raising both the first and later attempts.
Notably, at 1.7B, the first attempt of In-Weight RSI (41.99%) already exceeds Base + In-Context RSI after ten refinements (39.73%), consistent with the compression of later attempts into the first attempt ( Theorem 1 ).
blocks.zh:
第三,培训的成果也延续到推论时间的完善。
具体来说,整个框架的增益超过基数13.89% Base + 内部 RSI + 7.33%.
因此,即使可以推论对内文加以改进,内重的RSI也会有所帮助,这既增加了第一次尝试,也增加了以后的尝试。
值得注意的是,在1.7B时, " 内重 " 倡议的首次尝试(41.99%)已经超过 Base + In-Context RSI 经过十次改进(39.73%),与后来的尝试压缩为第一次尝试一致(定理1 .

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.3 违约

blocks.en: We consider each component in turn, first the refinement design of In-Context RSI and then the distillation design of In-Weight RSI.
blocks.zh: 我们依次考虑每个构件,首先是精细的In-Context RSI设计,然后是In-Wight RSI的蒸馏设计.

blocks.en:
Table 2: In-Context RSI design ablations. Qwen3-4B accuracy, fix/break rates and balance points (%), averaged over AIME26 and HMMT26.
Balance points are computed per benchmark before averaging.
The best accuracy and balance point are in bold.
blocks.zh:
表2:Context RSI设计图。 Qwen3-4B精度,固定/断速率和平衡点(%),平均高于AIME26和HMMT26.

blocks.en:
To examine how the two design choices of In-Context RSI (see Section 3.2 ) affect refinement, we compare it with three variants ( Table 2 ). Final answer only retains just the final answer of a k a_{k} , directed reference use instructs the policy to check and correct a k a_{k} , and unrelated reference replaces a k a_{k} with a solution to a different question from the same benchmark.
Alongside accuracy, we report the fix rates, break rates and balance points of Proposition 1 , with rates pooled over the chain and estimated in a separate evaluation batch.
The full design raises mean accuracy from 53.84% to 63.59% after ten refinement steps.
Replacing the full solution with only its final answer lowers mean accuracy ( −4.28% ) and roughly doubles the break rate, indicating that intermediate reasoning helps preserve correct solutions.
Directing reference use lowers accuracy ( −3.16% ) and the fix rate, suggesting that autonomous use leaves more room to correct earlier mistakes.
An unrelated reference performs below Base ( −3.23% ), showing that additional context alone does not provide the benefit of relevant prior reasoning.
The two design choices together improve refinement.
blocks.zh:
为了审查In-Context RSI的两个设计选择(见第3.2节)如何影响完善,我们将其与三个变体进行比较(表2)。 最后答案只保留 k a_{k} 的最后答案, 直接的引用使用指示 检查和校正 k a_{k} , 不相关的引用用一个与同一基准不同的问题的解决方案取代 k a_{k} 。
除了准确性外,我们还报告第1号提案的固定费率、断裂费率和平衡点,在链条上汇集费率,并分批评估。
经过10个改进步骤后,整个设计的平均精度从53.84%提高到63.59%。
仅用其最终答案来取代完全的解决方案,则意味着精度(−4.28%),并且大约是断裂率的两倍,这表明中间推理有助于维护正确的解决方案.
指导参考使用较低的精度(−3.16%)和固定率,这表明自主使用为纠正先前的错误留下了更多的空间.
在Base(−3.23%)下进行不相关的参考,表明仅靠附加上下文并不能提供相关先前推理的好处。
这两种设计选择共同改进了完善。

blocks.en:
The balance points reflect the same pattern.
Unrelated references have the highest fix rate but also introduce frequent regressions, yielding the lowest balance point.
Full-solution references and autonomous use balance correction with preservation, giving In-Context RSI the highest balance point.
Across the four settings, these balance points track observed accuracy within 1.83%.
blocks.zh:
平衡点反映了同样的模式。
无关的参考文献的固定率最高,但也经常出现回归,得出最低的平衡点。
完全解决引用和自主使用平衡校正与保存,使In-Context RSI成为最高的平衡点.
在四种设置中,这些平衡点跟踪观测到的精确度在1.83%以内。

blocks.en:
To test whether supervising both behaviors ( Section 3.3 ) improves on either alone, we train the two distillation terms separately and together (see Table 3 a).
Recursive Distillation outperforms refinement distillation, the stronger single term, by +1.95% on AIME26 and +1.01% on HMMT26.
We then add Accelerated Distillation to test whether coupling improves the first attempt, obtaining further gains of +1.11% and +0.76% , respectively.
Training both behaviors and coupling their guidance therefore strengthen the first attempt.
Finally, to assess the value of deeper supervision, we add a third adjacent pair, in which a teacher given a 3 a_{3} supervises a student given a 2 a_{2} .
It yields only +0.28% on AIME26 and matches In-Weight RSI on HMMT26 ( Proposition 3 in Appendix A ), while requiring another generation.
We therefore retain two reference solutions per update.
blocks.zh:
为了检验监督这两种行为(第3.3节)是否单独改善,我们单独和一起培训两个蒸馏术语(见表3a)。
递归式蒸馏比精炼式蒸馏更好,单词更强,在AIME26上为+1.95%,在HMMT26上为+1.01%.
然后我们加入加速蒸馏,测试结合是否改善第一次尝试,分别获得+1.11%和+0.76%的进一步收益。
因此,培训行为和结合其指导加强了第一次尝试。
最后,为了评估更深入监管的价值,我们增加了第三个相邻的对子,其中一位老师给一个3 a_{3}监督一个学生给一个2 a_{2}。
它在AIME26上只产生+0.28%,在HMMT26(附录A中建议3)上与Win-Wight RSI匹配,同时需要另一代.
因此,我们每次更新都保留两个参考解决方案。

blocks.en: 4.4 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 分析

blocks.en: Having shown that training strengthens refinement, we now examine how these gains feed back through references, how far they extend, whether they reach questions that the majority gets wrong, what they cost, and how they accumulate during adaptation.
blocks.zh: 在表明培训可加强改进之后,我们现在审查这些成果如何通过参考反馈、其延伸程度、它们是否达到多数人误解的问题、其成本以及它们在适应过程中如何积累。

blocks.en:
We compare references generated by the current and initial policies under the same distillation objective (see Table 3 b).
Generating references with the evolving policy improves first-attempt accuracy by +1.67% on AIME26 and +3.79% on HMMT26 over using the fixed initial policy.
After ten refinement steps, the advantages are +8.89% and +3.79% , respectively.
Evolving references therefore improve both the first and final attempts.
This matches the bootstrap analysis ( Theorem 1 ): fixed initial-policy references always provide the same one-step targets, whereas evolving references let the gains compound across updates.
Together with the stronger refinement observed after training ( Section 4.2 ), this shows how improvements in the policy and its references reinforce one another.
blocks.zh:
我们比较同一蒸馏目标下现行和初步政策产生的参考文献(见表3b)。
根据不断演变的政策生成参考,在使用固定初始政策时,在AIME26和HMMT26上分别提高+1.67%和3.79%的第一试精度。
经过10个完善步骤,优势分别是+8.89%和+3.79%.
因此,不断演变的参考资料既改进了第一次尝试,也改进了最后尝试。
这与“靴子”分析(定理1)相吻合:固定的初始政策参考总是提供相同的单步目标,而不断演变的参考则让收益在整个更新过程中复合。
加上培训后观察到的更强有力的改进(第4.2节),这表明政策的改进及其参考内容如何相辅相成。

Compared with Base, mean target accuracy improves by +2.37% and +3.05% , respectively.

These transfer gains show that the improvement is retained in the model weights and applies to new questions.

To test whether refinement-based training can overcome an initially wrong majority, we evaluate the In-Weight RSI model and the baselines with 64 independent answers per question on AIME26, focusing on the six questions whose Base majority is wrong ( Table 5 a), where avg@64 averages the 64 answers and SC@64 is their majority vote.
Several self-consistency-based baselines perform below Base on this subset, illustrating how training on agreement can reinforce an initially wrong answer.
On these questions, In-Weight RSI raises avg@64 from 5.73% to 12.76% ( +7.03% ), exceeding OPSD-TTT’s 8.33% by +4.43% .
Self-consistency also becomes correct on two of these questions, compared with one for OPSD-TTT.
Overall avg@64 improves by +4.79% over Base and +3.69% over OPSD-TTT, the strongest baseline in this comparison.
This demonstrates that training on refinements raises accuracy on questions whose majority is wrong, not only on those the model already answers correctly by majority.

以下若干基于自我维持的基线 基于这一子集,说明关于协议的培训如何能够强化最初错误的答案。
在这些问题上,In-Wight RSI将avg@64从5.73%提高到12.76%(+7.03%),比OPSD-TTT的8.33%提高到+4.43%。
在其中两个问题上,自我一致性也变得正确,而OPSD-TTT则是一个问题。

这表明,关于改进的培训提高了多数问题准确性,而不仅仅是模型已经以多数正确回答的问题。

blocks.en:
To compare In-Context RSI with Self-Consistency at inference, we plot mean accuracy over AIME26 and HMMT26 against mean cumulative generated tokens per question ( Figure 3 ).
In-Context RSI exceeds the accuracy of ten-sample self-consistency at its fifth attempt while generating 68.6% fewer tokens, demonstrating more efficient inference scaling without weight updates.
At comparable total token cost, it retains an accuracy advantage of +2.13% .

In-Context RSI在第五次尝试时超过了十样自相容的精度,同时生成68.6%的代币,显示出在不更新重量的情况下更高效的推论缩放.
在可比的总代币成本中,它保留了+2.13%的精度优势.

blocks.en:

With pipelined reference generation, In-Weight RSI takes 8.53 minutes on AIME26 and 10.06 on HMMT26, giving a speedup of 2.29 – 5.36 × \times per update over the baselines.
It also uses the fewest tokens per update, 0.95M on AIME26 and 1.12M on HMMT26, reducing the cost of its self-supervision.
Together with the inference savings above, these results show reduced training time and inference token cost.

blocks.en: 5 Related work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Parallel scaling aggregates independent solutions ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Brown et al., 2024 ) , while sequential methods build on earlier attempts by revision or re-solving ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Tian et al., 2025 ) .
Repetition and limited exploration can restrict these gains ( Gu et al., 2026 ; Rance et al., 2026 ) .
Compute can also be allocated within a single attempt, by its reasoning length ( Guo et al., 2025 ) or by the effective depth of the architecture ( Liang et al., 2026 ) , rather than by the number of attempts.
In-Context RSI preserves exploration by letting the model decide whether and how to use full-solution references, and In-Weight RSI distills the resulting refinements.
blocks.zh:
平行缩放集成独立溶液(Wang等人,2023年;Brown等人,2024年),而顺序方法则以先前的尝试为基础,通过修订或重新溶解(Madaan等人,2023年;Tian等人,2025年).
重复和有限的勘探可以限制这些收益(Gu等人,2026年;Rance等人,2026年)。
计算也可以在一次尝试中,根据其推理长度(Guo等人,2025年)或架构的有效深度(Liang等人,2026年)来分配,而不是根据尝试的次数来分配.
In-Context RSI通过让模型决定是否以及如何使用完全解决方案的参考文献来保留探索,In-Wight RSI对由此产生的改进进行提炼.

blocks.en:
This line of work adapts models on unlabeled test inputs using self-generated supervision ( Sun et al., 2020 ; Akyürek et al., 2025 ) .
TTRL rewards majority agreement ( Zuo et al., 2025 ) , and TTPO distills solutions selected by self-consistency ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
Other methods use agreement to select teacher references ( Gkountouras et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) or sharpen confidence ( Zhao et al., 2026b ; Agarwal et al., 2025 ) .
In-Weight RSI uses successive solutions as teacher references, obtaining guidance from refinement rather than majority agreement.
blocks.zh:
本工作线采用自制监理方式调整无标签测试投入模型(Sun等人,2020年;Akyürek等人,2025年).
TTRL奖励多数协议(Zuo等人,2025年),TTPO通过自我一致性选择的蒸馏溶液(Wang等人,2026年).
其他方法使用协议选择教师参考(Gkontouras等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年)或增强信心(Zhao等人,2026年b;Agarwal等人,2025年).
In-Wight RSI使用相继的解决方案作为教师参考,从完善而不是多数协议中获得指导.

blocks.en:
Training on self-generated attempts has been studied with correctness feedback ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Kumar et al., 2025 ) and in recursive training frameworks ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , which a recent survey organizes by how far the improvement loop is closed ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
Recent systems evolve algorithms and agents ( Novikov et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) or consolidate deployment experience into model parameters ( Ye et al., 2026 ) .
On-policy self-distillation uses contextual information to construct dense teacher supervision ( Zhao et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2026 ) .
TT-RSI connects in-context improvement with weight updates by distilling successive self-generated refinements, forming a test-time amplify-then-distill loop ( Anthony et al., 2017 ; Christiano et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh:
研究了关于自我生成尝试的培训,并提供了正确的反馈(Zelikman等人,2022年;Kumar等人,2025年)和递归性培训框架(Lee等人,2026年),最近的一项调查对改进循环的关闭程度进行了组织(Chen等人,2026年)。
近代系统进化算法和代理(诺维科夫等人,2025年;张等人,2026年)或将部署经验整合为模型参数. (Ye等人,2026年) (中文(简体) ).
政策上的自我消化利用背景信息构建密集的教师监督(Zhao等人,2026a); 吴等, 2026).
TT-RSI通过蒸馏连续的自我生成的改进,将内文本改进与重量更新连接起来,形成一个测试时间放大-当时-distill环(Anthony等人,2017年;Christiano等人,2018年).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented TT-RSI, a label-free framework for improving LLMs at test time.
In-Context RSI lets the model autonomously build on prior solutions, which In-Weight RSI uses as teacher references to strengthen answering and refinement.
Our analysis shows how local distillation compresses and amplifies improvement toward the model’s infinite-step refinement limit.
Across three model scales and five benchmarks, TT-RSI gains +13.89% over Base and +4.79% over TTPO + SC on average.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了TT-RSI,这是测试时改进LLMS的无标签框架.
In-Context RSI让该模型自主地建立在先前的解决方案上,In-Wight RSI用它作为教师参考,以加强回答和完善.

blocks.en:
Following the released implementation ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , TTPO selects eight training trajectories from 64 non-thinking candidates per question.
A teacher conditioned on the majority answer supervises agreeing trajectories through Soft-OR-weighted forward KL, while a group-relative policy-gradient term penalizes disagreements.
blocks.zh:
发布实施(Wang et al., 2026)后,TTPO从每题64名非思维考生中选出8个训练轨迹.
以多数人回答为条件的教师通过Soft-OR加权前方KL监督商定轨迹,而群体相对政策分级的术语则惩罚分歧。

blocks.en:
TTRL optimizes the policy with GRPO using agreement with the sampled majority as its reward ( Zuo et al., 2025 ) .
In the training-cost comparison, it generates eight thinking trajectories per question and reuses each batch for two updates.

TTRL利用与抽样多数达成的协议作为奖励,优化了与GPRO的政策(Zuo等人,2025年)。
在培训成本比较中,每题产生8个思维轨迹,每批重复使用2个更新.

blocks.en:
OPSD-TTT uses the current policy’s generated final answer to condition a frozen initial-model teacher ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
The teacher supervises one non-thinking student rollout per question through clipped forward KL.
LoRA and optimizer settings follow Table 6 .

blocks.en:
CANON samples 32 solutions per question and selects the solution with the highest mean token log-probability among those reaching the majority answer ( Gkountouras et al., 2026 ) .
This full solution conditions a frozen teacher, and the question-only student is trained with Jensen–Shannon divergence over the sampled rollouts.
blocks.zh:
CANON对每个问题的32个解决方案进行抽样,并在获得多数答案的人群中选择最高平均符号对数概率的解决方案(Gkontouras等人,2026年)。
这个完全的解决方案给一个冷冻的老师带来了条件,而只问问题的学生则在Jensen-Shannon对样本推出的分歧中接受培训。

blocks.en:
U-OPSD samples eight rollouts per question and uses a majority-agreeing solution as the teacher’s reference to supervise disagreeing rollouts through clipped forward KL ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
The training-cost comparison uses thinking mode for generation and distillation.
